lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's one? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 1? Nope!

lines.text: p is a prime bigger than three. Divide p squared plus seventeen by twelve.
lines.caption: p is a prime bigger than 3. Divide p² plus 17 by 12.

lines.text: Take seven. Seven squared is forty-nine dots.
lines.caption: Take 7. 7² is 49 dots.

lines.text: Remove a corner dot, and slide the bottom row to the side.
lines.caption: Remove a corner dot, and slide the bottom row to the side.

lines.text: Now it's six by eight. The neighbors of seven!
lines.caption: Now it's 6 by 8. The neighbors of 7!

lines.text: One neighbor is a multiple of six, and the other is even.
lines.caption: One neighbor is a multiple of 6, and the other is even.

lines.text: So p squared is a multiple of twelve, plus one.
lines.caption: So p² is a multiple of 12, plus 1.

lines.text: One plus seventeen is eighteen. That leaves six!
lines.caption: 1 plus 17 is 18. That leaves 6!

lines.text: One is the trap. It forgets the seventeen.
lines.caption: 1 is the trap. It forgets the 17.

lines.text: Did you get six? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 6? Tell me below!
